# Camp Resource: Nuka Cola Mystery Machine

This marvelous Nuka-Cola Mystery Machine holds every Nuka-Cola variety you could ever want! But which one will you get?

Be warned, there is a 5-minute restocking period before you will be able to quench your thirst again.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Nuka Cola Mystery Machine__

**Produces**

- Nuka-Cherry: 3.63%
- Nuka-Cola: 40.50%
- Nuka-Cola Cranberry: 1.50%
- Nuka-Cola Dark: 1.50%
- Nuka-Cola Grape: 3.63%
- Nuka-Cola Orange: 3.63%
- Nuka-Cola Quantum: 1.50%
- Nuka-Cola Twist: 40.50%
- Nuka-Cola Wild: 3.63%

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

Americana Nuka Cola Mystery Machine, Classic Nuka-Cola Mystery Machine

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

N/A - Refer to the cooldown period

**Obtainable via**

Season 11 Scoreboard - Nuka World - Free

Gold Bullion - Mortimer - Cautious - 1250 Bullion

**Produces X amount per**

5 min (300 seconds) cooldown period.

**Lockable**

15 caps per use

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit
